findings.motion: Author of HB 1670, proof of citizenship to verify eligibility to vote
findings.note: Author of HB 1670, which would require documented proof of citizenship to register to vote, to the extent federal law allows, and asks the Secretary of State to set the rules. It was referred to the Elections committee on 2025-03-12.

findings.note: Listed among the authors of HB 5138, which gives the attorney general a duty to prosecute criminal offenses under state election laws. The record shows the Senate appointed conferees on 2025-05-29.
